summary: 2026-27 home kit. The club's official partnership page lists 14 partners for the 2026/27 season: main partner ('Бас Серіктес') Samruk-Kazyna, plus SportQory, Alatau City Bank, BBK Foundation, Yandex Taxi Kazakhstan, SvoyDom, World Class Astana, MYD, ASU (unidentified, site dead), Gas Energy, Digital Boards, Ailand, sXodim and TTC (Transtelecom) — recorded as 'partner' placements. The club's information partners (Qazsport, BestNews, sXodim media, Vesti.kz, Sports24) are media partners and not listed here, and KHL league sponsors are handled as league deals. Which logos appear on the game jersey (front, back, sleeves) is not yet sourced, so sponsorsComplete stays false.
